es: !! mas limpio: NQ (A+8, zona mas cerca de precio y mejor confluencia del tablero, aunque sigue en WAIT por el conflicto de marcos).
Sizing: limite $1000 por cuenta (K=3 stops) deja GC en 0 contratos full y NQ/ES en 1 -- piensa en micros para GC.
en: !! NQ: the 7-day bearish thesis broke in Asia (a sustained reclaim over 29707 and acceptance above VAH 29799-29813, with ES/YM not confirming); CL: the 9-session bullish run took its first real break (downside acceptance, no EIA in progress), though the hard 95.29 invalidation is still untouched.
NQ: ex-7-day short BROKEN, accepted above VAH/day high 29799-29814; WAIT, frame conflict blocks GO despite an A+8 zone waiting for rejection.
ES: the daily flipped bullish, but 3-day structure/thesis hasn't confirmed; WAIT at the 7763-7773 premium cluster (A+7), no trigger yet.
GC: the 2-day bounce still has no background backing and is in confirmed chop; WAIT, the edge favors the 4190-4195 VAL but confluence is thin (B3).
YM: reclaimed the old cluster with authority, but it's the one NOT confirming NQ's new high; WAIT, the 52508-52525 ONH/VAH zone (A+6) untouched.
CL: the 9-day run took its first real crack, accepted lower almost into the 96.06-96.78 reversal zone; WAIT, 96.97-97.27 retest (B5).
cleanest: NQ (A+8, closest zone to price and the board's best confluence, though still WAIT on the frame conflict).
Sizing: the $1000 per-account limit (K=3 stops) leaves GC at 0 full contracts and NQ/ES at 1 -- think micros for GC.

ES/YM didn't confirm that high (a fresh bearish SMT divergence): watch in London whether they reject there (revives the week's short) or ES/YM finally confirm with their own new high (fully buries the bearish thesis).
